assessments.reasoning: TOML v1.0.0 Inline Table makes braces self-contained and explicitly prohibits defining keys or subtables outside them. The product cases establish both adding to an inline table and applying a later inline table to an already defined table as invalid. A new unrelated sibling key is not such an extension.

challenge.method: Compared external dotted addition, external child header and an independent sibling, then checked the v1.1.0 multiline difference.
challenge.results: The v1.0.0 inline table is closed; independent siblings are fine. v1.1.0 adjusts multiline/trailing comma syntax but does not contradict the scoped closure rule.

limitations: This concerns the inline-table form. A standard table follows different declaration rules.
The assessment is confined to the named documents and revision scope.
